query:
SELECT 'delegate_double_bookings' as check_name, COUNT(*) as violations FROM (
  SELECT attendeeId, timeSlot, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM meetings
  GROUP BY attendeeId, timeSlot
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) x
UNION ALL
SELECT 'repeat_meetings' as check_name, COUNT(*) as violations FROM (
  SELECT attendeeId, sponsorId, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM meetings
  GROUP BY attendeeId, sponsorId
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) x
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sponsor_over_capacity' as check_name, COUNT(*) as violations FROM (
  SELECT sponsorId, attendeeNumber, timeSlot, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM meetings
  GROUP BY sponsorId, attendeeNumber, timeSlot
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) x
UNION ALL
SELECT 'total_meetings' as check_name, COUNT(*) as violations FROM meetings;
